senses.gloss: Used to indicate that a statement explains or supports a previous statement. See anyhow and at least.
The last part of a word.
A morpheme added at the end of a word to modify the word's meaning.
The replaying of something previously recorded, especially sound or moving images.
A perennial European herb, Nasturtium officinale, that grows in freshwater streams; used in salads and as a garnish.

To search or attempt to find something in the dark, or, as a blind person, by feeling; to move about hesitatingly, as in darkness or obscurity; to feel one's way, as with the hands, when one can not see.
Any seabird belonging to the genera Uria and Cepphus of the auk family Alcidae. They have black and white bodies and are good at swimming and diving.
Sexual activity, usually sexual intercourse unless preceded by a modifier.
Of unsound mind; insane; demented.
Insane; crazy, mentally deranged.
Exhibiting unsoundness or disorder of mind; not sane; utterly mad.
(colloquial) Very fond of (on) someone.
mentally disturbed or unsound
Crazy, insane, mad.
An insane person.
Insane.
Low in fat, calories, alcohol, salt, etc.
To a small extent or degree.
Dilute, lacking in taste or potency.
Having less than average weight.
Light in composition, notably low in fat, calories etc. Most commonly used commercially.
Enjoyably lacking of seriousness, not grave.
Intended for or used by homosexuals, as a nightclub, a bar, etc.
Of a near-vertical gradient; of a slope, surface, curve, etc. that proceeds upward at an angle near vertical.
At or forming a right angle (to something).
The action of rubbing, kneading or hitting someone's body, to help the person relax, prepare for muscular action (as in contact sports) or to relieve aches.
A disease, occurring especially in women following menopause, in which the bones become extremely porous and are subject to fracture.

A grammatically complete series of words consisting of a subject and predicate, even if one or the other is implied. In modern writing, when using, e.g., the Latin, Greek or Cyrillic alphabets, typically beginning with a capital letter and ending with a full stop or other punctuation.
The sediment at the bottom of a liquid, or from which a liquid has been filtered.
(archaic, chiefly, in the plural) Dregs, sediment.
The sediment settled at the bottom of a liquid; the lees in a container of unfiltered wine.
The probability of something happening.
The quality of being possible.
clouding of the lens in the eye
Aksu River (Xinjiang).
Of or pertaining to a clinic, such as a medical clinic or law clinic.
A medical facility, such as a hospital, especially one for the treatment and diagnosis of outpatients.
The proportional relationship between one amount, value etc. and another.
The relative magnitudes of two quantities (usually expressed as a quotient).
The act of surveying; a general view.
(in extended senses of the above) A mass of people, a mob or muster, considered as a head count.
The action of asking questions; a survey; an inquiry.
A form containing a list of questions; a means of gathering information for a survey.
The nerve-dense, retractable fold of skin which covers and protects the glans of the penis in humans and some other mammals.
ideal accepted by some individual or group
Any of various gobies of the subfamily Oxudercinae that are able to survive out of water by breathing through their skins and having strong pectoral fins that act as simple legs.
The or an act of taking.
(uncountable) An embrace, a grasp, or handshake.
(obsolete) That which is grasped; a handle; a grip.
The handle of a tool or weapon.
Willing to take either a penetrative (top) or receptive (bottom) role in anal sex.
(historical) Africa; that is, the part of North Africa known in classical antiquity.
A form of soured cream or crème fraîche from Central and Eastern Europe.
Something resembling snow (etymology 1, noun sense 1) in appearance or color.
Any of various insects in the family Formicidae in the order Hymenoptera, typically living in large colonies composed almost entirely of flightless females.
Resulting from, characterized by, or indicating, ambition.
Showy, bold or audacious in behaviour, appearance, style, etc.; ostentatious.
Of ostentation.
The state or quality of being active; activeness.
A violent collision or compression; a crash; destruction; ruin.
Opposition; contradiction; such as between differing or contending interests, views, purposes etc.
An instance of colliding.
A brief battle between small groups, usually part of a longer or larger battle or war.
Movable rails which can be used to switch a train from one railway track to another.
place where railways meet
A tool used for cutting thin material, consisting of two crossing blades attached at a pivot point in such a way that the blades slide across each other when the handles are closed.
A structure made up of one or more triangular units made from straight beams of wood or metal, which is used to support a structure as in a roof or bridge.

A cutting tool used to remove parts of stone, wood or metal by pushing or pounding the back when the sharp edge is against the material. It consists of a slim, oblong block of metal with a sharp wedge or bevel formed on one end and sometimes a handle at the other end; there are hand tool versions (the original type) and versions as bits for power tools.
(rail transport) A switch on a railway used to move a train from one track to another.
The manipulation of railway rolling stock into different combinations or onto different tracks.
A en given name.
A deep red color, somewhat less vivid than scarlet, the traditional colour of a Catholic cardinal's cassock. (same as cardinal red)
A city in Kurdistan, Iraq.
(historical) An ancient city in what is now northwestern Turkey.
A person or (especially) a company who publishes, especially books.
Synonym of pure and virtuous, particularly
dignity, status, or esteem
A special characteristic or quality; prestige, especially via association.

A facial expression comprised by flexing the muscles of both ends of one's mouth, often showing the front teeth, without vocalisation, and in humans is a common involuntary or voluntary expression of happiness, pleasure, amusement, goodwill, or anxiety.
Inevitably; of necessity.
The third letter of the Greek alphabet (Γ, γ), preceded by beta (Β, β) and followed by delta, (Δ, δ).
Undue expansion or increase, as of academic grades.
The official legal document outlining the charges concerned; bill of indictment.
A room or a house designed for heat sessions.
In an intravenous manner; by means of intravenous injection.
Any of very many animals (either hermaphroditic or nonhermaphroditic), of the class Gastropoda, having a coiled shell.
(uncountable) A dish, commonly associated with French cuisine, consisting of edible snails.
Any member of a class of molluscs (Gastropoda) that includes snails, slugs, and limpets; univalve mollusc.
Any of many gastropod mollusks, having no (or only a rudimentary) shell.
A coat of mail; especially, the long coat of mail of the European Middle Ages, as contrasted with the habergeon, which is shorter and sometimes sleeveless.
Something that coasts or is used to coast.

A framework of timbers, or iron bars, moving upon ways or rollers, used to support, lift, or carry ships or other vessels, heavy guns, etc., as up an inclined plane, or across a strip of land, or in launching a ship.
(British) any type of sled or sleigh.
A vehicle, generally pulled by an animal, which moves over snow or ice on runners, used for transporting persons or goods. (contrast "sled", which is smaller)
The sport of racing on luges.
A long sled without runners, with the front end curled upwards, which may be pulled across snow by a cord or used to coast down hills.
Hallucinogenic.
hot and humid; oppressively sticky
A similar brown liquid obtained from coal tar used as a wood preservative.
Not published.
A grain or seed, especially of a cereal crop.
Corn; a type of grain of the species Zea mays.
Any of a group of various types of grass or its grains used as food, widely cultivated in the developing world.
(archaic) Coarse meal; groats.
A hash of various kinds of meats; a ragout.

A small ball of chemical pesticide (originally camphor and now typically naphthalene or paradichlorobenzene) and deodorant placed in or around clothing and other articles to deter moth larvae which may damage them.
An independent city in Saxony, Germany.
Pertaining to a current or recent time and style; not ancient.
The act of one who scouts.
A simplified representation of a smiling face.
The systematic and scholarly study of language.

A region in the eastern United States, covering a part of the Appalachian Mountains, that stretches from southwestern Pennsylvania to northern Alabama, usually excluding New York State and New England.
A small, thin piece of building material, often with one end thicker than the other, for laying in overlapping rows as a covering for the roof or sides of a building.
An umbelliferous plant, of genus Heracleum, most species of which are phototoxic.
A soothing ointment.
A fastening consisting of two metal rings, designed to go around a person's wrists, and connected by a chain or hinge.
One ring of a locking fetter for the hand or one pair.
A province of Central Visayas, Visayas, Philippines. Capital and largest city: Tagbilaran.
A subjective aesthetic quality of out-of-focus areas of an image projected by a camera lens.
A tractor with caterpillar tracks and an attached blade for pushing earth and building debris for coarse preliminary surface grading, demolishing building structures, etc.
(informal) A bulldozer.
The part of a bridle or halter that goes over the nose of an animal, particularly a horse.
To make (something) smaller or as small as possible; shrink; reduce.
A city and port in southern Croatia, on the Adriatic Sea; formerly, Ragusa.
Unconstrained.
(not, _, comparable) Of or relating to etymology.
In general usage, an essential part of a thing surrounded by other essential things.
A frame or housing containing electrical or mechanical equipment, such as on a computer.
That which encloses or encases.
A central article or figure.
(organic compound) Any of a class of aromatic heterocyclic compounds containing a ring of four carbon atoms, two double bonds and an oxygen atom; especially the simplest one, C4H4O.
publication
An agricultural tool whose blades are at right angles to the body, similar to a pickaxe.
An (often walled) area of a city in which Jews are concentrated by force and law. (Used particularly of areas in medieval Italy and in Nazi-controlled Europe.)
A person who makes, dispenses or sells lenses, spectacles.
Difficult to please; quick to find fault.
Instructed; having knowledge of a fact or area of education.
A cheese pastry from the country of Georgia in the Caucasus region of Eurasia.
Enlargement of the spleen (process); an enlargement of the spleen (instance).
word with the same sound or spelling
A metallic chemical element with an atomic number of 70.
A city, the administrative center of Ivanovo Oblast, Russia.

Any tree of the genus Catalpa, in the family Bignoniaceae. The two North American species, the southern catalpa, Catalpa bignonioides, and the northern catalpa, Catalpa speciosa — along with the yellow catalpa, Catalpa ovata, from China — are often planted as ornamentals because of their showy flowers and decorative bean pods, though others regard the bean pods as a nuisance.
Agent noun of slide: that which slides.
Inexperienced.
with sharp taste
To attain maturity, to become mature or ripe.
A derogatory hint or reference to, or (often sexual) insinuation about, a person or thing.
An unusually small penis.
To weep, lament persistently or bitterly.
A strong, pressurized, heated vessel, as for laboratory experiments, sterilization, cooking or mineral processing.
(religion) A temple dedicated to all the gods.
local or general law enforcement agency
A mixed woodland-grassland biome and ecosystem characterised by the trees being sufficiently widely spaced so that the canopy does not close.
To become aware of the loss or absence of; to feel the want or need of, sometimes with regret; to feel sadness at the absence of somebody or something.
Any of a group of inherited disorders in which the amount of hemoglobin in the blood is reduced.
Something that causes amazement or awe; a marvel.
An event that appears inexplicable by the laws of nature and so is held to be supernatural in origin.
divine story
To mend by sewing on a piece or pieces of cloth, leather, or the like.
To repair by stitching with thread or yarn, particularly by using a needle to construct a weave across a damaged area of fabric.
To physically repair (something that is broken, defaced, decayed, torn, or otherwise damaged).
To issue (something) in large quantities.
One of the male (masculine) sex or gender.

The male erectile reproductive organ used for sexual intercourse that in the human male and other placental mammals is also used for urination; the tubular portion of the external male genitalia (excluding the scrotum).
An unspecified large number (of).
Instructive or intended to teach or demonstrate, especially with regard to morality.
